subject: Request: Executive approval for >20% Hosted API concession for Avery Labs pilot
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@averylabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Price <oliver@averylabs.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask ahead of pilot kick-off

Hey Ben —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Our engineering team is ready to run a 6-month pilot (up to ~60M tokens/month) to validate inference quality for our virtual assistant product.

Budget is tight for this fiscal quarter. To move forward quickly we need a commercial concession: can Redwood provide a 25% discount off list hosted API usage for the pilot term, plus an SLA for latency under 200ms 95th p50 on the endpoints used?

We can sign a short pilot agreement and agree to a go/no-go review at month 4. If things look good, we plan to convert to a committed dedicated deal.

Appreciate a fast yes/no — our executive sponsor is pushing to close this week.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product, Avery Labs

Attachments: Avery_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@averylabs.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask ahead of pilot kick-off

Samira —

Great to meet you yesterday. Really excited about the pilot and the expected usage pattern. I think a pilot makes a lot of sense and we want to be accommodating for strategic logos like Avery.

Short answer: I can offer a 20% promotional pilot rate immediately under standard T&Cs, but anything >20% needs exec signoff (our deal desk asks that I escalate). Two asks from our side to approve higher concession:
- Agreement to a 6-month fixed-term pilot (not month-to-month) with a month-4 performance review.
- Limited marketing reference and a case study opt-in on successful conversion.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and contract for your review. Irene (cc'd) — can you take this to Laura for exec approval? The request is for 25% off hosted API usage, pilot capped at 60M tokens/month, and SLA commitment for latency on the endpoints we discussed.

Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: HostedAPI_Contract_Draft.docx
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request: 25% concession for Avery Labs pilot (RD-2027-AVY-0123)

Laura —

Escalating a clear >20% concession ask for a strategic pilot with Avery Labs. Summary below for quick review — full thread and draft SOW/contract attached.

Snapshot:
- Customer: Avery Labs (product: voice assistant)
- Ask: 25% discount off list Hosted API usage for pilot (pilot = 6 months, up to 60M tokens/month)
- SLAs requested: latency 95th <= 200ms on specified endpoints; standard uptime SLA
- Committed value if converted (sales estimate): ~$150k ARR in year 1 (conservative); strategic value: reference customer in vertical X, potential to convert to Dedicated capacity in Q1 next year
- Conditions we can require: 6-month fixed pilot, month-4 performance review, public reference & joint case study opt-in, proof of SOC2 controls (they provided SOC2_summary.pdf)
- Risks: below-market pilot unit economics if they hit 60M tokens; increased support/observability needed for SLA window

Attachments: Avery_SOW_v1.pdf, HostedAPI_Contract_Draft.docx, SOC2_summary.pdf

Recommended ask: Approve a one-time 25% pilot concession under the conditions above, with a clearly staged conversion playbook and guardrails (consumption caps, auto-escalation to Dedicated routed through Deal Desk at 80% of cap). If approved, we will provision a dedicated rate card for the pilot and hand to RevOps to track.

If you want, I can rephrase the final concession with a clause that limits the discounted rate to the first 100M tokens in aggregate across the pilot term to protect unit economics.

Appreciate a rapid decision; customer wants to finalize by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@averylabs.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: 25% concession for Avery Labs pilot (RD-2027-AVY-0123)

Irene / Ben / Samira —

Thanks for the clear summary and the diligence on guardrails. I approve a 25% pilot concession with the following mandatory conditions (please add to the contract before signature):
1) Pilot term fixed to 6 months; discount applies only to the first 100M tokens in aggregate across the pilot. Any consumption beyond that reverts to our standard published rates unless a separate approval is obtained.
2) Month-4 formal performance review and go/no-go checkpoint.
3) Avery (customer) must sign the case study opt-in clause; execution of the pilot is contingent on that opt-in (marketing may redact sensitive material).
4) RevOps to create a monitored billing alert at 75% of the token cap and auto-notify Deal Desk at 90% usage.
5) SLA commitment limited to measured endpoints in the SOW; we will not extend blanket latency guarantees beyond the agreed endpoints.

Irene — please update the contract (add the 100M token cap language and monitoring) and send DocuSign link to Samira. Ben — take point on the exec intro and case study language. RevOps: loop in Derek to set alerting and billing protections.

Approving this concession now. Laura

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
